summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing for QC Inspect MVP. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases passed (auth, products, checklist, inspection lifecycle, numeric auto-eval PASS/FAIL, CCP append + auto-eval, submit locking + overall FAIL/PASS, role scoping QC vs admin, dashboard stats, daily report, photo upload + protected file fetch). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844): login (qc@qc.com) -> dashboard KPIs -> Start New Inspection -> Honey Cake -> batch form -> Start Checklist -> add CCP readings (180=PASS, 200=FAIL with proper badge) -> fill numeric/passfail/yesno/dropdown items -> Review screen shows OVERALL FAIL with failures list -> Submit -> back to dashboard with updated KPIs (Completed 4, Failed 3, Checks 21). History and Daily Report screens both render correctly with real data (11 inspections, 5 CCP monitored, 3 pass, 2 fail). All backend API calls returned 200. No blocking issues. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

issues: Minor: 'Reading saved · FAIL' toast overlaps the header title on narrow screens (see /tmp/06_ccp_added.png). Consider moving toast below header or shortening title.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on web, but should set useNativeDriver=false explicitly where used to silence warnings.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from a library-level component; low priority.

action_items: Optional: Split /app/backend/server.py (~840 lines) into modules (auth, inspections, reports, storage) — exceeds 700-line guideline.
Optional UI polish: Position the in-app toast (app-toast) below the header so it doesn't overlap the batch/product title on the inspection screen.
Optional: Silence the two RN-Web console warnings (useNativeDriver, props.pointerEvents) — cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single file of ~842 lines mixing auth, products, inspections, reports, storage, seeding — consider splitting into routers.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct for Expo web) — verified via src/api/client.ts responses hitting the public host.
MongoDB `_id` is properly excluded from every response (verified across all endpoints).
Auth uses HTTPBearer with JWT (7-day expiry), bcrypt password hashing, role-based dep — no hardcoded creds.
Inspection snapshot pattern correctly preserves the checklist version at inspection-time for auditability.
CCP readings are $push (append-only) — verified via GET after two POSTs returned 2 entries.
seed_data_creation: Tests created many TEST_-prefixed inspections and one TEST_ registration user via /api/auth/register. All backed by production_date=today (2026-08-25). No cleanup performed; QC executive scope keeps them out of other users' views.
